contexts.text: Like a shell without a kernel. AC 6587:end. AC 9925. AC 10194.
Like a husk and chaff in comparison with the kernel.
As it were nuclei in the skull... Such nuclei, which are indurations, with those who are being reformed, are broken...
Of whom it may be said, that his shell... is wise, and his kernel... is insane.

The internals with the good are like the kernels within in their soundness and goodness... But... with the evil their internals are like kernels which are not eatable on account of their bitterness, or which are rotten, or worm eaten...
They thus pervert the nucleus or nature [of man].
Such... form as it were nuclei in the left side of my head.
The life of persuasion constitutes the shell, and the life of nature the kernel...
By Noah is signified the Church which... lasted in the posterity as a nucleus or axis.
The opinion in which a man is, or his assumed principle of life, is like a nucleus...
(The charity in which a man lives) may be compared to a kernel...
Then all these things are like a shell without a kernel...
